observations: Photos show a SHARP copier/printer unit still wrapped in plastic on a pallet/crate.
Photo 0 and photo 2 show the model marking clearly as “SHARP AR-M207”.
Photo 1 shows the side with “SHARP AR-M207” partially visible and additional paper-size labels (A4/A3) on the front/side area.
No clear view of control panel, screen, toner/toner door, paper trays, or any ports/connectivity.
No photo shows the machine powered on, printing, or any error/status display.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location/usage history; only the machine is shown wrapped.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic marketing; no photo/spec sheet or powered-on proof.
Photos show “SHARP AR-M207” (photo 0 and photo 2), not M307.

risks.risk: Wrong model listed (seller says M307 but photos show AR-M207). This can change compatibility, parts, and market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model nameplate/label and the full front control panel showing the exact model (unwrapped or close-up).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the photographed unit (AR-M207) but treat the listing as unreliable; if you cannot confirm, price at the worst-case for a used copier with uncertain configuration.

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (no power-on/print test shown).
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine powering on and running a test print/copy (showing no error codes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs service/unknown faults).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables (toner, drum, staples/finisher, trays, power cable) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo checklist: toner/drum status, all trays/doors, power cable, and any included accessories/attachments.
risks.if_unproven: Price as base unit only, with consumables/attachments not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Potential shipping damage or internal issues (unit is wrapped; damage may be hidden).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of corners/edges and a powered-on status check for jams/error codes.

proof_requests: Unwrap and take a close-up photo of the model label plus the full front control panel (to confirm AR-M207 vs any other model).
Power-on video showing the screen/home state and a successful test copy/print (with no error messages).
Photos of toner/drum area and all paper trays/any finisher/stapler attachments (if included).
Photos of ports/connectivity and a quick inspection of physical corners/hinges for shipping damage.
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a SHARP AR-M207, but the seller’s text conflicts (claims M307) and there is no proof the machine works (no power-on/print test). Without confirmation and working status, a safe price cannot be set.
